title: GENERATOR & FORWARD LAMP WIRING HARNESS, GENERATOR WIRING
summary: Generator (alternator, A.C. generator) wiring: the generator & forward lamp harness runs along the LH fender skirt in clips to the alternator. A harness bracket bolts to the alternator with a lock washer, the battery lead goes on the alternator BAT terminal stud with a nut and a rubber boot, and the 18DG lead goes to the engine water temperature switch (temp sending unit), shown in View A.

fastening.note: Bolt [3] goes through the harness bracket/clip and lock washer [2] into a threaded hole in the generator housing.
The battery lead eyelet goes over the generator's own BAT terminal stud (no callout); nut [4] holds it. Boot (part of harness) is then pushed over the terminal.

fastening.to: engine (View A, cylinder head / intake area at front of engine)
fastening.note: View A: water temperature switch [5] threads into the engine; the 18DG harness lead connects to it.

notes: Position boot over battery terminal after connection is made so that small end of boot points upward.
notes_internal: Item 1: callout box with no part (removed by rev 5).
Rev 4 old nut pn hand-written; 4th/5th digits run together, written 121??3.
Rev 1 text read as 'ITEM 5 & TORQUE ADDED'.
Harness clips along the fender ('CLIPS') have no callout.
Circled 3 and 4 next to items 1 and 4 in the list; circled 2 at View A; circled 5 at the boot.
